Your own fields on our records, defined per business so each book keeps its own vocabulary. A definition sets the label, the type and whether a value is required.

Values filter through the ordinary list grammar as `cf_<api_name>`, e.g. `?cf_plan_tier[is]=gold`, and are resolved per request from that business's definitions — which is why they cannot be listed as fixed query parameters on the list endpoints. Archiving a definition is soft and leaves existing values in place.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/custom_field_definitions`](/help/developers/api-reference/custom-fields/list-custom-field-definitions) | List custom-field definitions |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/custom_field_definitions`](/help/developers/api-reference/custom-fields/define-a-custom-field) | Define a custom field |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/custom_field_definitions/{id}`](/help/developers/api-reference/custom-fields/get-a-custom-field-definition) | Get a custom-field definition |
| `PATCH` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/custom_field_definitions/{id}`](/help/developers/api-reference/custom-fields/edit-a-custom-field-definition) | Edit a custom-field definition |
| `DELETE` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/custom_field_definitions/{id}`](/help/developers/api-reference/custom-fields/archive-a-custom-field-definition) | Archive a custom-field definition |
